label: Customer Journey Mapping
description: Map and optimise customer journeys across all touchpoints from first awareness through to advocacy. Identify friction points, moments of truth, and high-impact improvement opportunities.

claudeKnowledge.description: Customer journey frameworks, CX best practices, touchpoint analysis methodologies

options.label: Full customer lifecycle — awareness to advocacy
Acquisition journey — awareness to first purchase
Onboarding journey — first purchase to active user

guidedInputs.label: Customer segment(s) to map
guidedInputs.description: Which customer persona(s) or segment(s) is this journey map for? Be specific about who they are.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Enterprise procurement manager, age 40-55, evaluating software vendors. Or: first-time online buyer, price-conscious, mobile-first...

guidedInputs.label: Key touchpoints in the journey
guidedInputs.description: Which channels and touchpoints are part of this customer's experience?

guidedInputs.label: Known friction points or drop-off areas
guidedInputs.description: Where do you already know customers get stuck, drop off, or express frustration?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., High drop-off on the pricing page. Many trial users do not complete onboarding. Support tickets spike in the first 30 days. Churn occurs mostly at 3-month mark...

guidedInputs.label: Customer insight data available
guidedInputs.description: What data or research do you have to inform the journey map?
